title: Business Development Executive
description:
An excellent opportunity has come up with a growing, global company who specialises in business innovation and business change. We are looking for a Business Development Representative to work within a successful sales team.

As the Business Development Representative, you will generate new sales opportunities and add qualified leads to the sales funnel. You will be responsible for prospecting, following up opportunities, and passing on qualified leads to other sales agents who will convert them into new customers.

The Business Development Representative will be responsible for the following:
- Generating leads by cold calling prospective clients
- Follow up on marketing campaigns and engaging with and developing prospects
- Document, track and monitor all leads and activities in the CRM
- Identify opportunities for campaigns
- Nurture relationships with longer term prospects

The successful Business Development Representative will have the following related skills / experience:
- Highly motivated and a self-starter
- Strong desire to meet and exceed quota on a monthly basis
- Comfortable with prospecting and cold calling to a global market
- Excellent telephone manner with confident negotiation skills
- Previous sales experience would be advantageous

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive
35,000 - 50,000 + Commission + Training and Development
Wokingham, Berkshire
Are you a Business Development Executive, Telesales professional or BDR looking to join a well-established design and build company where you will be developed, trusted to run your own desk, and rewarded for the results you deliver? Do you want a role where you are given quality leads, a proven process, and the autonomy to build long-term client relationships in the office fit-out market?
On offer is a permanent position with a respected specialist in office fit-out, where you will receive hands-on training through shadowing and coaching, and have clear goals based progression as you build your pipeline and earnings.
This business has been established and continues to grow, backed by strong structure and investment, and they are now looking to add to their business development team as a result of continued expansion.
In this role you will be office based, working from a lead and client system, making outbound calls, following up warm activity, researching target businesses, handling objections and booking qualified appointments. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, developing an understanding of design and build projects including Cat A and Cat B fit-outs.
This role would suit someone with phone-based sales or business development experience, looking to develop their capability, take ownership of their own pipeline, and progress through performance and results.
The Role:
- Outbound business development across warm and cold leads, booking qualified appointments
- Researching target clients and building a strong database and pipeline
- Learning the design and build fit-out sales cycle, including Cat A and Cat B works

The Person:
- Phone-based sales, telesales or business development background
- Driven mindset with resilience and strong communication skills
- Ideally some exposure to construction, office fit-out or design and build sales

title: Recruitment Consultant / Sales Consultant
description:
SW-007-SalesConsultant-290

Recruitment Consultant / Sales Consultant

Social Housing & Property Maintenance Sector

£27,000 - £35,000 per annum + Uncapped Commission
Permanent Position
Based in Reading, Berkshire

The Opportunity
- ITS Property Maintenance are looking for an enthusiastic, commercially driven and outgoing Recruitment Consultant / Sales Consultant to join our specialist Property Maintenance team based in Reading
- The role combines business development, account management and recruitment, with the opportunity to develop your own portfolio of clients, contacts and candidates within the Property Maintenance market
- We're looking for somebody who enjoys speaking to people, building relationships, winning business and creating opportunities
- Previous recruitment experience would be advantageous, although we're equally interested in people with a strong B2 B sales or business development background
- Experience or existing knowledge of the Social Housing, Property Maintenance, Facilities Management (FM) or Construction sectors would be a particular advantage, giving you an understanding of the clients, contracts, projects and people operating within our marketplace.

What Will You Be Recruiting?

You'll recruit temporary and permanent staff across our specialist Property Maintenance and Social Housing division.

Typical vacancies include:
- Multi-Traders, Carpenters, Plumbers, Electricians & other Maintenance Trades
- Site Managers, Supervisors & Contracts/Project Managers
- Surveyors & Quantity Surveyors
- Planners, Schedulers & Administrators
- Resident Liaison & Customer Support staff

Your Role

You'll become an integral part of our established Property Maintenance team, developing existing accounts while identifying and winning new business.

Building Your Business

A successful Recruitment Consultant doesn't simply wait for vacancies to arrive.

You'll be encouraged to actively develop your market through client research, contract intelligence, candidate marketing, referrals, meetings, networking and proactive business development.

Ultimately, you'll take ownership of your own specialist market and develop a profitable recruitment desk within the wider ITS Property Maintenance business.

What We're Looking For

Ideally you'll have experience within recruitment, B2 B sales, telesales, business development or account management.

We're looking for someone who is:
- Confident and comfortable developing new business
- Outgoing with strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Commercially minded and motivated by targets and results
- Resilient and comfortable working in a sales environment
- Organised and able to manage clients, candidates and vacancies
- Proactive, hardworking and willing to take ownership of their market
- Comfortable working independently while remaining part of a team
- Previous Social Housing, Property Maintenance, FM or Construction experience would be particularly beneficial.

What You'll Receive
- £27,000 - £35,000 basic salary, depending on experience
- Uncapped commission
- Established specialist Property Maintenance recruitment market
- Existing client and candidate relationships
- Leading recruitment job boards, CV databases and recruitment technology
- Sales and marketing support
- Hands-on training, mentoring and development
- Opportunity to build and manage your own recruitment desk
- Genuine long-term career and earning progression

Why ITS Property Maintenance?

We want someone who wants to help us build a business that becomes an industry leader within Property Maintenance and Social Housing recruitment

You'll work alongside experienced, successful and top-billing recruitment professionals, including an industry-leading consultant with over 20 years' experience setting up and running Social Housing Maintenance recruitment divisions and teams

That experience includes previously building a specialist recruitment business within this market to multi-million-pound annual turnover

You'll therefore be learning from people who understand how to build a desk, develop a market, win clients and turn recruitment activity into sustainable revenue

You'll have an established brand, specialist market, experienced team, recruitment technology, candidate databases and existing industry relationships behind you

The opportunity is there to build something substantial, and we want someone ambitious enough to come on that journey with us

Full UK Driving Licence

A full UK driving licence is required as the role will involve attending client meetings, offices, depots and operational sites.

Next Step

If you're currently working within Recruitment, Sales, Business Development or Account Management and want the opportunity to build your own market within an established specialist team, we'd like to hear from you.

We'd be particularly interested in hearing from recruiters or sales professionals with experience or contacts within Social Housing, Property Maintenance, Facilities Management or Construction.

We're looking for somebody who doesn't just want their next recruitment job but wants to build a desk, develop a market and become a key part of an industry-leading Property Maintenance recruitment business.

Apply today and a member of the ITS Property Maintenance team will contact you for an informal conversation.

ITS Property Maintenance are acting as an employment agency in relation to this permanent vacancy.

salary_text: £24000 - £50000 per year (+ Commission and great benefits)
description:

Our client are an award-winning leader in the car and van leasing industry. Thier continued growth and success is driven by strong values of honesty, hard work, and integrity, alongside high-performing individuals and premium customer service.

- Comprehensive training and development opportunities.

title: Account Executive
description:
Account Executive

Bracknell, Berkshire 30,000 + Benefits

Love building relationships? Know how to turn happy customers into growing accounts?

We're looking for a commercially minded Account Executive to join an established, market-leading business providing innovative workplace safety and security technology.

This isn't a role where you'll spend your days cold calling. You'll be working with an existing portfolio of B2 B customers, building relationships, uncovering opportunities and helping businesses protect their people through innovative technology.

If you enjoy the commercial side of account management and get a buzz from growing customer accounts, this could be a great next step.

What You'll Be Doing
- Taking ownership of an established portfolio of B2 B customer accounts.
- Building strong relationships and becoming the go-to contact for your customers.
- Spotting opportunities to upsell and cross-sell products and services.
- Growing account revenue while maintaining excellent customer retention.
- Running customer review meetings to identify new requirements and opportunities.
- Delivering engaging online presentations and product demonstrations.
- Working towards achievable monthly and quarterly sales targets.
- Collaborating with internal teams to ensure customers receive outstanding service.

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with Account Executives, Account Managers or Account Development professionals who enjoy building relationships and driving commercial growth.

You'll ideally bring:
- Experience managing and developing B2 B customer accounts.
- A track record of generating additional revenue from existing customers.
- The commercial awareness to spot opportunities and convert them into sales.
- Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.
- A proactive, organised approach and confidence using CRM systems.

You don't need to come from the security industry. We're more interested in your ability to build relationships, understand customer needs and grow accounts.

What's In It For You?
- 30,000 basic salary plus additional benefits.
- An established customer portfolio to develop and grow.
- A relationship-led sales role rather than a cold-calling position.
- The opportunity to work with innovative products that genuinely help keep people safe.
- A well-established business with a strong reputation in its market.
- A varied role offering plenty of customer interaction and commercial responsibility.

Ready for Your Next Move?

If you're an Account Executive or Account Manager who enjoys developing customer relationships, identifying opportunities and growing revenue, we'd love to hear from you.

Click Apply and send us your CV today.

Our recruitment team will review your application and contact you to discuss the opportunity further if your experience is a suitable match.

Take the next step in your sales career with a business where your relationship-building skills can make a real difference.

Coburg Banks Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Client Service Executive
description:
Our client is going through an exciting period of growth and is looking to recruit a Client Services Administrator (Property), to join their team in Bracknell.

Please note that this is NOT a Sales role. You will NOT be required to sell properties yourself

Our client is happy to consider candidates who have previously worked within the property industry as well as candidates who come from outside the industry. No-matter what background you come from, you MUST be able to demonstrate a good academic ability and be committed to working hard and learning in a fast-paced environment. (Psychometric testing will form part of the interview process).

The company provide an outsourced service to their clients, selling properties on their behalf. This team specifically supports the process by acting in their clients' best interests; ensuring the best possible outcome is always achieved.

- Confident communicator - both verbal and written
- Resilience, positivity, and able to work in a fast-paced environment

- Strong organisational skills

The role:

- Liaising with third parties

- Managing incoming enquiries

title: Customer Services Executive
description:
We are seeking a proactive and relationship-driven Customer Success Manager to join our client's growing team.

Working within a small team of Customer Success Managers, you will play a key role in building lasting customer relationships, providing ongoing post-sale support and ensuring clients gain maximum value from the services provided.

This is a varied role combining customer support, account management and relationship development, with opportunities to strengthen partnerships and contribute to business growth.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as a key point of contact for customer enquiries, escalations and ongoing support, ensuring queries are resolved efficiently.
- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with customers and strategic partners, developing an understanding of their needs and objectives.
- Manage the customer onboarding process, delivering tailored training sessions, live demonstrations and feature walkthroughs.
- Conduct regular customer check-ins and business reviews, gathering feedback and identifying opportunities to improve satisfaction and retention.
- Develop collaborative relationships with external service providers, vendors and strategic partners.
- Work closely with third-party partners and internal operations teams to resolve complex account issues.
- Collaborate with the Sales team to support customer renewals and strengthen existing relationships.
- Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through upselling and cross-selling, while developing strategies to re-engage previous customers.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in a Customer Service, Customer Success or Account Management role.
- A customer-first approach, with a genuine passion for building relationships and resolving problems.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritise competing demands.
- A proactive approach to identifying opportunities to improve customer experience and develop existing accounts.

Details:
- Salary: 26,000- 32,000 DOE, plus a 10% bonus based on individual and company KPIs.
- Location: Newbury (fully office-based).
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm.
- Contract: Permanent, full-time.

If you possess a customer-first mindset, excellent communication skills, and a track record of effectively managing a varied workload, we would love to hear from you.
